# BB00397 {.unnumbered}

Unto God belongeth the Ha' in its entirety, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Ha' exalted, tremendous.

Unto God belong the tokens of Ridvan, one and all, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of favours all-glorious, all-glorious.

Unto God belong the subtilities of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a tenderness wondrous, tremendous.

Say: God is my Lord, and He, verily, is my support. On Him do I rely, and sufficient is God as a Protector.

There, guardianship belongeth unto God, the True One, and sufficient is God as a Trustee.

Unto God belongeth the Waw in its entirety, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Waw tremendous.

Say: God is the Creator of all things, and He, in truth, hath power over all things.

Unto God belong the subtilities of the whole Cause, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a tenderness tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the whole of the seed and harvest, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of an increase and plantation tremendous.

Unto God appertaineth the whole of the Cause, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Cause tremendous.

Unto God belongeth guardianship in its fulness, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a guardianship tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the Za' in its entirety, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Za' tremendous.

Unto God appertaineth the whole of the Cause, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Cause tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the Standard of Truth, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a standard exalted, tremendous.

Unto God belongeth praise within the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a praise tremendous.

Unto God appertaineth the whole of the Cause, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Cause tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the Ha' in its entirety, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Ha' tremendous.

Unto God belongeth guardianship in its fulness, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a guardianship tremendous.

Unto God appertaineth the whole of the Cause, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Cause tremendous.

Unto God belong the subtilities of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a tenderness tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the fragrance of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a sweet savour tremendous.

Unto God appertaineth the whole of the Cause, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Cause tremendous.

Unto God belongeth guardianship in its fulness in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a guardianship tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the Ta' in its entirety, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Ta' tremendous.

Say: God is my Lord, in the beginning and in the end, and God, of all things, is all-knowing.

Unto God belongeth the Standard of Exaltation, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a standard tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the certitude of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a certitude tremendous.

Say: God is my Lord and your Lord; on Him do I rely, and sufficient is God as a Helper.

There, guardianship belongeth unto God, the True One—He is more abundant in hosts and greater in sovereignty.

Unto God belongeth the Ya' in its entirety, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Ya' tremendous.

Say: God is my Lord, and He, verily, is my Beloved, to draw me unto Himself through His bounty; and sufficient is God as a Well-Beloved.

Unto God belong the subtilities of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a tenderness tremendous.

Unto God belongeth all majesty and glory in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a majesty tremendous.

Say: God is the Creator of all things through His command, and God, in truth, hath ever been powerful over all things.

Unto God belongeth the unique prerogative regarding sons and daughters. Say: Verily, the Prophet and the Imams have a prior claim to them above all other people, and the bounty of God upon them is indeed immense.

Unto God belongeth the Kaf in its entirety, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been the Possessor of a Kaf tremendous.

God hath made manifest that:

> "O company of the creation of God! Ye must all read, then believe, and attain certitude."
